structure_reason_diagnosis.caveat: conviction/structure_reason/range_position schema only exists on the core (safe/bold) decision path from 2026-08-19 onward -- NOT present for fleet arms (safe-1/safe-3/risky-1/risky-3) at all, and not present for core-path PLACED rows before 2026-08-19. This sub-analysis covers a SMALLER, LATER population than the main time-of-day population above.

verdict.headline: REFUTED as an actionable gate. Day-level bootstrap CIs for every one of the 5 time-of-day buckets cross zero (n=9-27 distinct days per bucket after correcting for shared-signal multi-arm pseudo-replication). The two negative-looking buckets (09:35-09:50 and 12:00-14:00) are each a single-day artifact: excluding ONE day (2026-08-14 for the early bucket, 2026-08-07 for the midday bucket) flips both to net positive. All 3 candidate later-entry gates (09:45/09:50/10:00) either worsen the book or cannibalize a named winning day (08-13 and/or 08-27) by 48-114% of that day's total P&L, because those two winning days' single biggest wave IS a 09:41-09:52 simultaneous multi-arm entry.
verdict.structure_reason_subfinding: The diagnostic half of H7 (structure_reason=unknown:insufficient_bars concentrated in the 09:35-09:50 window) IS supported on the data that exists for it, but that data only covers 2026-08-19 onward (conviction/structure_reason schema does not exist before that date, and never exists on the 4 fleet arms) and n=10 early-bucket PLACED rows total: 5/10 (50%) show structure_reason=unknown:insufficient_bars vs 2/86 (2.3%) at 09:50+. This is a real, plausible mechanism (bull trigger threshold lower than bear -> fires before the structure classifier has warmed up) but is UNDERPOWERED (n=10) and cannot by itself justify a gate given the winning-day cannibalization shown above.
